scripts.check-all: echo --Run all pre-commit check-ups-- && npm-run-all check-types check-biome && echo --All checks passed--
scripts.check-and-test: echo --Run all pre-commit check-ups and tests-- && npm-run-all check-all test && echo --All checks and tests passed--
scripts.clear-all: echo --Clear all cache and temp files-- && rimraf node_modules/.cache .next && jest --clearCache && echo Cleared cache
scripts.dev: echo --Run nextjs server in devepment mode-- && next dev --turbo
scripts.build-debug: echo --Build the project in debug mode-- && cross-env __NEXT_MANGLING_DEBUG=1 next build --no-mangling
scripts.scripts-help: echo --List all available script commands-- && npm-package-user-scripts-list
